1\. Async signal receivers rejected 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
Every changed Signal.send call now omits _async_wrapper=app.ensure_sync, so Blinker raises when
a connected receiver is a coroutine instead of executing it synchronously. This breaks async
receivers across request, exception, teardown, context, flash, and template signals, causing the
associated operation to fail.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description The PR removed Flask's `ensure_sync` adapter from every public signal dispatch.
